segments.sn48.51:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati sālāya brāhmaṇagāme.
segments.sn48.51:1.4: “seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā, sīho migarājā tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – thāmena javena sūrena [sūriyena (sī. syā. kaṃ.)];
segments.sn48.51:1.5: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāya”.
segments.sn48.51:2.2: Saddhindriyaṃ, bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn48.51:2.3: vīriyindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn48.51:2.4: satindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn48.51:2.5: samādhindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn48.51:2.6: paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn48.51:2.7: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā, sīho migarājā tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – thāmena javena sūrena;
segments.sn48.51:2.8: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāyā”ti.
